# αβ.net (Alpha Beta Network)

> > A comprehensive Python code protection platform offering encryption, obfuscation, and secure distribution tools for developers and enterprises.

αβ.net is a research project by YPY AI LAB providing cloud-based and local solutions for protecting Python intellectual property through encryption, obfuscation, and licensing. The platform supports cross-platform deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux with tools ranging from command-line utilities to standalone executable builders.

## Key Topics

- Python code protection
- Code obfuscation
- Code encryption
- Source code security
- Intellectual property protection
- Cross-platform compatibility
- Licensing and authentication
- Hardware ID generation
- Python binary compilation
- Secure distribution
- Cloud platform
- Command-line tools
- Standalone executables
- Python 3.6+
- YPY AI LAB

## Core Products

- [Secure Python Code Manager](https://xn--mxac.net/secure-python-code-manager.html): Cloud platform for secure Python code encryption, obfuscation, and licensing
- [Local Python Code Protector](https://xn--mxac.net/local-python-code-protector.html): Command-line tool for local Python code encryption and obfuscation
- [Python App Bundle Shield](https://xn--mxac.net/python-app-bundle-shield.html): Creates protected standalone executables from Python scripts with obfuscation
- [Python Binary Optimization Compiler](https://xn--mxac.net/python-binary-optimization-compiler.html): Compiles Python code into optimized native binaries for performance and security

## Development Tools

- [Multi-Version PYZ Builder](https://xn--mxac.net/multi-version-pyz-builder.html): Creates cross-platform Python modules with multi-version compatibility
- [System Hardware ID Generator](https://xn--mxac.net/system-hardware-id-generator.html): Generates unique hardware IDs for device authentication and licensing
- [Python Performance Benchmark Tool](https://xn--mxac.net/python-performance-benchmark-tool.html): Benchmarks and compares Python code performance across versions

## Services & Support

- [Professional Services](https://xn--mxac.net/services.html): Custom Python code protection and development services by YPY AI LAB
